text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I totally bombed the math quiz...!! 
Arrrgh, I'm so pathetic, waaahhh!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
I've gotta put more grit into studying...! 
But I can't go cutting down on my training 
time either...!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Then, how about we use math formulas for 
our training callouts?! Like "Sine, 
Cosine, Tangent!"

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
"...Actually, I don't even know what sine 
and cosine are in the first place, to be 
honest..."
